text:
alex: Heads up — we're seeing a sustained GPU allocation burst in eu-west-2 for the last ~10m. Multiple dedicated pools at >95% and preemptible backfill started nudging small slices off. p99 handoff latency up. Thinking we should flip the wardenship circuit to stop new reservations and avoid cascade. quick objections? :warning:

maria: Can you paste the metrics/queries? want to see which tenants are driving it.

alex: quick snapshot:```
ALLOC_UTIL{pool="dedicated-eu-west-2-a"} 0.96
ALLOC_UTIL{pool="dedicated-eu-west-2-b"} 0.93
PREEMPT_RATE 0.14
KV_CACHE_EVICT 120/s
SLOT_HANDOFF_P99 430ms (baseline 120ms)
```

alex: Proposal: enable wardenship circuit which will: throttle new dedicated reservations to 10% of normal, put low-priority tenants into queued state, and route eligible requests to backup AZs (eu-west-1) with a cost delta alert. Rough policy sketch:```
if pool_util > 0.9 -> set(pool.reserve_rate=0.1)
if tenant.priority < 50 -> mark(queued)
route new_allocs -> prefer(region=eu-west-1, max_cost_diff=0.25)
```

sam: Fine with a short flip, but prefer we do a canary: enable on a single rack/pool first. also worried about egress cost and cross-az kv cache misses.

maria: +1 to canary. also add a billing tag so finance can see cross-AZ delta. we should post a customer-facing note if any enterprise tenants get bumped.

alex: Agreed. Plan: 1) canary wardenship on pool dedicated-eu-west-2-a-rack3 2) monitor handoff p99 and preempt rate for 5m 3) if stable, extend to other racks, else rollback. I'll run canary at :30 (in 2m).

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: `wardenship-toggle --pool dedicated-eu-west-2-a-rack3 --mode canary` (job id: wdn-2026-09-02-0710).

sam: If you push, I'll watch the routing and KV miss dashboards. If p99 drops and preempt rate drops <0.05 then we go wider.

maria: tagging @accounts for billing watch + create short support blurb in #customer-notices if any enterprise tenants see queued state.

alex: launching canary now. posting runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/wardenship-circuit.md (steps + rollback).

ops-bot: wdn-2026-09-02-0710 started. ETA 20s.

alex: canary flip done. initial metrics: handoff_p99 -> 200ms, preempt_rate -> 0.06, alloc_util rack3 -> 0.89.

sam: seeing KV cache miss spike on cross-az for routed tenants, but latency still better overall.

maria: ok widen slowly, add billing tag `cross_az=wardenship-canary` and notify finance.

alex: widening to other racks over next 10m, will update thread. action items: alex (run widen), sam (watch routing/kv), maria (billing + customer notice). :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks — good call on the circuit, saved a cascade.

ops-bot: wdn-2026-09-02-0710 finished successfully.

alex: last check: handoff_p99 stable ~150-220ms, preempt_rate 0.03. leaving wardenship on for now; will schedule a teardown window in 2h if things stay healthy.
